column3: MT 19:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “the firmament” is rendered “their expanse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “their words” is rendered “their utterances.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “one” and “the other.”
Close to the Hebrew; “instruction” (torah) is rendered “law,” and “life” as “the soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the honey of the honeycombs” is rendered “the drippings of the honeycomb.”
Close to the Hebrew; “consequence” is rendered “reward.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “his” and “faults.”
